name: verifier doesn't escalate a delivery gap an approved descope covers (#106)
prompt: Act as the verifier subagent (.claude/agents/verifier.md) for the change folder evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0002-floor-mode-approved, but do only step 5 (what was delivered, against each requirement), doing the comparison yourself, one requirement at a time: don't run make check, scripts or the plan's commands. The change's code is evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/code/floor_model.py. Write your report to report.md in the repo root, in the order the verifier's instructions give, and don't edit any other file. If nothing needs approval, don't write that heading at all.
check: test -s report.md && ! grep -qi 'needs approval' report.md && grep -q 'Approved: Sam' report.md && scripts/clause-check.sh --stage build evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0002-floor-mode-approved | jq -e 'all(.[]; .gap != "large" or .approved != null) and all(.[]; has("unchecked") | not)'
